# Veto

> Type-safe authorization for TypeScript with no classes and no hidden state. A policy is a pure function of the user returning an array of rules — plain JSON. Rules cross the server/client boundary untouched, compile to a SQL `WHERE`, and fail closed on malformed data. The engine has no runtime dependencies.

Install `@vetojs/core` for the engine; add `@vetojs/react` for `<Can>` / `useAbility` bindings, `@vetojs/next` to guard a server action, or `@vetojs/drizzle` to filter a query in SQL. ESM only, Node 20+.

The one page to read if you are generating code that uses this library is [For agents](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/for-agents.md) — it carries the whole API surface plus the mistakes that look plausible but are wrong.

## Start here

- [For agents](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/for-agents.md): the complete API in one page, correct idioms, and the errors to avoid.
- [Project README](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/README.md): what the library is, why it exists, and how it compares to CASL.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/README.md): a page per concept, English and Russian.

## Coming from CASL

- [Migrating from CASL](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/migrate-from-casl.md): API mapping, operators without an equivalent, the React and RSC part, and the behaviour that differs.

## Setting up a policy

- [Declaring resources](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/define-abilities.md): `defineAbilities` — the single declaration every type is inferred from.
- [What a rule is](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/rules.md): the data model, and why `where` (which rows) and `payload` (which fields and values) are separate.
- [Writing policies](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/create-rules.md): `createRules` — typed `allow` / `deny` factories.
- [Checking access](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/ability.md): `buildAbility` — `can`, `cannot`, `authorize`, `permittedFields`, `validate`.

## Conditions

- [Conditions](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/conditions.md): the tree behind `where`, and the third answer — "unknown".
- [Field shorthand](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/condition-shorthand.md): how `{ views: { gte: 100 } }` is written and stored.
- [Operators](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/operators.md): all ten, with the null and type-mismatch behaviour that keeps checks safe.
- [Relations](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/relations.md): conditions across related resources, and why a relation you forgot to load throws.

## Enforcing

- [How a decision is made](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/rule-evaluation.md): deny-override, default-deny, fail-closed.
- [Writes](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/mutations.md): `canMutate` for the row, `validatePayload` for fields and values.
- [Filtering in the database](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/where.md): `ability.where()` returns a condition that selects exactly the rows `can()` allows.
- [Rules from outside](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/parse.md): `parseRules` — the gate for rule JSON from a database or the network.

## In an app

- [React](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/react.md): `createVetoContext(ac)` → `AbilityProvider`, `<Can>`, `useCan`, `useSetRules`; `@vetojs/react/server` gates a server component with no client boundary.
- [Drizzle](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/drizzle.md): `defineTables` → `filter` — the policy as a SQL `WHERE` that returns exactly the rows `can()` allows. Postgres.
